## Reading the register

- A row is complete when every column is filled and the pass column shows all three parts. Today the passes are the work of #512, in the order shared components first.
- The exposure class drives DNS, Traefik, Authentik group access, NetBird policy, host firewall and JumpServer grants (all derived from this data as the exposure model lands).
- NIS2 and ISO 27001 rows come from CISO Assistant (ADR security/0002); until it runs, the per-ADR CISO mapping tables are the input.
